sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by FACS (FLAG M1 antibody) in HEK-293T cells (L1). Construct used for cryo-EM structure determination of full-length receptor (L3), indicating proper folding and membrane integration. Ligand-binding or G-protein signaling assay not reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: GHSR is a GPCR with no annotated signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–47 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 48. An N-terminal FLAG tag therefore sits on the extracellular face and cannot be cleaved. Because no clip names a specific residue, the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue = 0 (prepend before M1), residue_after = M (verified from the numbered sequence). Three independent publications using this exact construct, including one yielding a cryo-EM structure, provide high confidence that the tag is tolerated. Three independent studies (L1, L2, L3) expressed full-length, membrane-anchored human GHSR with an N-terminal FLAG tag in HEK-293T or insect cells. GHSR has no signal peptide (UniProt P49682; chain 1–366), so the N-terminus (residues 1–47, extracellular per topology landmarks) is the only extracellular terminus and the only location where an N-terminal tag can reside on the cell surface. L1 confirmed surface display by FACS with a fluorescent FLAG M1 antibody.

sources.claim: The surface expression of wtGHSR and various mutants in HEK-293T cells was determined and confirmed using FACS with a fluorescent FLAG M1 antibody (homemade).

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same N-terminal FLAG tag on full-length human GHSR; no internal extracellular loop insertion is reported in the ledger. L3 additionally carries a C-terminal 10×His tag, but the C-terminus (residue 366) falls within the intracellular span (324–366) and is therefore recorded in other_positions, not sites. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (102–117), ECL2 (182–208), or ECL3 (286–302), so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 10×His tag appended after residue 366 in the cryo-EM construct; residue 366 lies within the intracellular C-tail (topology landmarks: intracellular 324–366), so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface-display site.
